text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Past the 3rd corner, an unprecedented roar erupted.
Yes, this was it—this was truly it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A front-running blaze of pure burnout.
The run that Twin Turbo and I aimed for, piercing straight through the fans' hearts.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And into the straightaway they go!
Let it roar, Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaarrrghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Wide open throttle, the Turbo Engine goes wire-to-wire!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alllriiiight, did you see that, Teio?!
The run of your arch-rival, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Did all my friends see that too!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
S-Seriously...?! Super front runner, god front runner, or whatever...
Isn't that totally insane? Even we couldn't...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"She was in the zone. Or rather...
she completely blew past the redline..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: T-T-To take such a daring leap of faith...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Turbo... taught us
a lesson today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The light that had almost faded returns to everyone's faces.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Now Turbo has become a star of hope
that won't lose to Teio, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: With this run, I'm gonna beat Teio next time for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo declared that she would challenge Tokai Teio
with her fully perfected front-running style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later.
After returning to the training camp lodge—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
So, about the next race...
choice_data_list: Hmm, which race should we enter...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I decided on the All Comers.
It's a G2 at Nakayama, so I'm counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I already told her, so there!
Teio, who's staying behind at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, at that time, Tokai Teio
was supposed to be diligently doing rehab
at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ngggggh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... I see...
I really can't... do it anymore...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I... can't feel the blood flowing through my legs...
I'll never be able to run like I used to again...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A note on the dorm door?
What does it say...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Letter of Challange
I will wate for you at the Nakayama 'All Comers'!!
Twin Turbo"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Turbo just couldn't wait, ya know?
Besides, Teio'll definitely be fine by September!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Around 2,200 meters should be perfect for both Turbo and Teio, right?
So that's where I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that a bad move?
choice_data_list: Well, if you've already said it, there's nothing we can do.
No, if you already said it, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An early autumn GII isn't a bad choice at all.
The only problem is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's a high chance that fairly strong competitors
will enter the All Comers. But even so..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Tokai Teio really enters the race,
it's no use worrying about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt that if I could achieve a decisive victory over her, overall triumph would surely follow.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, then the "All Comers"
it is!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, the "All Comers"...
What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Turbo-san.
I'm scheduled to run in that race as well.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ikuno's running too!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, hooray!! That's gonna make things
even more hype!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo rejoiced. And... I felt like someone was watching us from afar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's just my imagination.
Maybe I was just imagining things...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer! Aiming for our showdown
with Teio, we're gonna do special training with Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Armed with the ultimate front-running style
she finally mastered, Twin Turbo enters
Nakayama's All Comers.
